text_block_list.text: With an amazing run, Gold Ship took 1st place in spectacular fashion!

Perhaps it's because having a rival
fired her up even more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We laughed together at times, and cried at others...
Looking back, it was just one detour after another...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Still, those days weren't in vain!
Because we were able to seize today's victory!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"This is true romance...
—Indeed, precisely because 'tis the season for marrons (chestnuts)!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Losing to this girl AGAIN...!!
Grrrrrrgh!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, today and the other day
were total flukes, okay! Next time I'm definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You wanna chat with me again?
You've got some good marron after all!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Then I'll wait for ya with another big one!
You better show up, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it!
I'm gonna win for real and make you regret it!

"Perhaps I might have another chance
to race against Tosen Jordan."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now then, guess I'll go look for some new marrons too—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Oh?
Something dropped where that person just passed by.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Umm... "Izo"?
choice_data_list: Could that be a new keyword?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I figured. Following "S" and "Kan"... comes "Izo", huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I still have no freakin' clue what that means!!

True to form,
a keyword was thoughtfully provided this time as well.

For everything to be prepared so meticulously,
there must be someone pulling the strings.
Just as I was thinking that—

Hmm, splendid! The bonds forged with comrades-in-arms
are truly an irreplaceable treasure!

Just like before,
a familiar voice echoed from somewhere.

The person who prepared the secret scroll and keywords.
It might be someone very close to us...!

"And that night—
Gold Ship had that dream again."
"O golden ship sleeping at the bottom of the sea..."
"Uncharted territory is right within reach... Now is the time to show everything you're made of—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Not again...
This is becoming an everyday thing, dammit...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So sleepy~... Maybe I'll practice my
'Knee-Elbow-Shoulder Trinity Posing'
to wake myself up~.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're spending your time on ridiculous nonsense
just like always, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Nakayama.
Want in on this too—hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: (What is this sense of déjà vu...? That voice and Nakayama... they sound alike?)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be you...?
The one barging into my dreams."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's a heavy question...
Did something seriously happen to you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? That wasn't it?
Never mind then... Just forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(I don't get it... but I can't shake the feeling
that Nakayama holds some kind of clue...)
